_doc: The Samurai's attacks and skills (GPT's REBORN direction v1.1, M3/M4 reviews and the v1.2 decisions). Times in seconds, distances in metres. kind: melee (a blade; its path baked) | projectile (thrown at its release event: speed, radius, range, height and ahead of his feet; capture: the hold a hit gives a target that can be captured) | pull (Chain Pull: the endpoint ahead of him; the drag takes the target's distance / speed, within min..max). button: the input that starts it; cond = a Legacy Chain opportunity (graph). aim_range: the aim assist's reach through startup. launch: a confirmed hit throws a launchable target up (height m, airtime s). air: the action is a leap at an airborne target (leap: he ends ahead m short of where the target will be at the strike, below m under its height, and at least min_hop m up — a late pursuit of a low target is still a visible jump); within: the farthest (m, flat) it may start from. spike: its confirmed blow in the air drives the target down — from start m/s, accelerating at accel m/s² up to top m/s (GPT's v1.3: a controlled slam, capped around 10 m/s; the impact deals no damage). kind step (Shadow Step): a burst of movement through the active window — distance m along the stick (backward when it is idle), his facing kept, collision-aware; defense: the defensive window, s from the start of the movement (GPT's v1.2: its first 120 ms) — an enemy blow that would have struck him then is evaded instead (a genuine evasion: the resolver's authoritative event, which opens Shadow Counter); evade: what "would have struck him" is tested against — shadow (GPT's v1.4 rule B): his Shadow Origin, the hurtbox where he stood when the movement began, through the whole window (a step blocked at once by a wall has no defensive window at all: GPT's v1.5 — a blow reaching him lands); body: his actual moving body. dash (Shadow Counter): through startup he dashes toward the opportunity's target (its attacker), following it, at most max m and stopping stop m short of its centre, with collision — then the strike; its startup lasts at least the dash's length over pace m/s (GPT's v1.5: max(0.15, d / 18) s — the move's startup played slower to fill it), and a press from beyond the whole dash plus its blade's reach is refused with its opportunity kept. kind seal (Explosive Seal): at its seal event the mark is planted on the opportunity's target — only if it is alive, its centre within seal.range m, a clear line from his chest to its chest, and it is sealable (data/targets.json); else the Seal missed (nothing planted, the opportunity spent); a press when it could not succeed at all (beyond range, blocked, gone, not sealable) is refused and its opportunity kept (GPT's v1.6). The mark detonates seal.fuse s after it was planted (on the target's own time: paused only while the target is held still by hit-stop, never by anything he does), dealing this action's damage, reaction and knockback (a push away from him); a detonation that damages the living, still-marked target is the authoritative event detonated. Phantom Execution: within — the farthest (m, centre to centre) it may start from (refused beyond, its opportunity kept); its dash stops stop m short of the target's centre, at most max m, speeding up into the cut (curve "in": the move's planted foot slides back faster and faster through the startup — the stride the dash carries out; GPT's v1.6: the move's root movement compensated). exit_blend: how long his stance blends back in after it (s) — the finisher's low ending pose eases out instead of snapping to idle. sounds: its own sounds (assets/audio/<name>.wav) as its active window opens and when it lands (for the Seal: its detonation). shake: the camera's jolt when it lands (0..1; by default 0.6 for a blow that pushes, else 0.22). blend: how long the move blends in (the Seal's palm thrust: through its startup). sequence: Explosive Execution's entry (GPT's v1.2) — these strikes in order, each a confirmed hit on the same target at most gap s (the combat clock) after the previous confirmed hit; the last one is the authoritative event sequence. aim_yaw: where the assist puts the target relative to his facing (degrees, + = his left) — the middle of a cut that runs to one side (Rising Slash's rising cut sweeps up his left, from 56° to 11°). graph: the Legacy Chain's edges — on an authoritative event (captured, launched, evaded, sequence, detonated), unlock an ability against the event's target for window s; rank: GPT's priority (1 first); requires: the target state it needs; cancel: the action whose recovery it may cut, from that fraction on. anim / anim_from / anim_speed: the move, where to start it and how fast to play it so its swing fills the active window. reaction: how long the target reels; knockback: how far it is pushed; lunge: his step into the cut. The blade's path through each active window is baked into samurai_blades.json by tools/bake_blades.mjs (re-run it after changing any timing or move here).
